data.body: FIXED by O5 (commit 5b33f87a40 on dd123-6, riding PR #684): added fallback_hops to validate-review-output.sh optional_top allowlist. The captured payload showed the actual root cause was the infra-emitted fallback_hops top-level key (not the originally-hypothesized frozen-field loop) — dispatch.py appends it post-LLM-output so correction can't strip it. ALLOWLIST not strip (588e panel: strip would mask malformed/empty payloads). RED->GREEN test + validator suite 96/96. Close when #684 lands. The frozen-field concern in this ticket's original framing was speculative and is not what the evidence showed.
